name: translate-text
description: Machine translation via the DeepL REST API — translate text into 30+ languages with optional formality control, list supported languages, and check your account usage.
author: Buildersoft LLC

fields.label: DeepL Auth Key
fields.helpText: DeepL API auth key (free keys end in :fx)

tools.name: translate.text
tools.description: Translate one or more text strings into a target language, with optional source language and formality.

text.description: Text to translate — a single string or an array of strings.

targetLang.description: Target language code, e.g. EN, DE, FR, EN-GB, PT-BR

sourceLang.description: Source language code (optional; auto-detected if omitted), e.g. EN, DE

formality.description: Formality of the translation (only supported for some target languages)

tools.name: translate.list_languages
tools.description: List the languages DeepL supports as translation sources or targets.

type.description: Which set of languages to list (default target)

tools.name: translate.usage
tools.description: Get character usage and the plan limit for the connected DeepL account.
